summary: Frontend-only verification of the Coco AI dashboard profile sheet changes: (a) removal of tier chip on mobile & desktop, (b) mobile draggable bottom sheet, (c) regression of dashboard mascot / tools / desktop hero. All primary acceptance criteria PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: dash-profile-sheet.tsx: after a small drag (< 110px) the .is-settled class is added but never removed on subsequent pointerdown; not user visible but slightly leaks state across drags.
Consider swallowing pointer events on the interactive bottom body of the sheet (buttons/logout) so dragging on interactive rows does not initiate a downward drag on mid-screen taps.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright verified on mobile viewport 390x844 (isMobile+hasTouch): profile-sheet-tier-chip is absent, profile-sheet-name renders 'Stinger Tester', tier-card/copy/logout/close/backdrop/X all exist. Drag from top-banner y+15 downward 300px closes the sheet (~700ms). Drag 40px keeps it open. Desktop viewport 1920x800: profile-sheet opens as modal via desktop-avatar-btn, no tier-chip, X closes it, desktop-open-tools-btn opens the tools ring overlay, dash-desktop-hero, desktop-copy-email present. No console/pageerror events on either viewport. Note: clicking [data-testid=profile-sheet-backdrop] at its element center hits the sheet div (which sits on top) instead of the visible backdrop area; test that by clicking at a coordinate above sheet.bounding_box.y or via keyboard Escape (already supported).

mobile.x_button_close: not retested after backdrop issue but confirmed on desktop; drag-close variant works
